The procedure is identical to the bump test except that, in step 3, select "Span Calibration" instead of "Bump Test", and the cylinder must deliver gas for 60 seconds (not 30). Successful span calibration updates the internal calibration certificate, which is logged with timestamp and operator ID and accessible via the maintenance menu under "Calibration Log".
